complaining.line: I don't want to sound complaining
stanza: I don't want to sound complaining
But you know there's always rain in my heart (In my heart)
I do all the pleasing with you, it's so hard to reason
With you, woah, yeah, why do you make me blue?

complaining.line: All you're doing is merely complaining
stanza: Shut your mouth and button your lip
You're a late night faucet that's got a drip

complaining.line: But that's alright by me, don't think that I'm complaining
stanza: Music-making still performs the normal functions:
Background noise for people scheming, seducing, revolting, or teaching

After all, it's only leisure time, isn't it?

Why are you on your own tonight?
And if you're so very entertaining
Why are you on your own tonight?
